'''Beatrice''' (Japanese: '''ベリー''' ''Berry'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|XY}} episode ''[[XY063|A Fork in the Road! A Parting of the Ways!]]''. She is a childhood friend of [[Dr. White]].

She had Dr. White check up on her {{p|Bidoof}} after it had become trapped in a cage by a {{OBP|Pokémon hunter|XY063}}. She vowed to go after the Pokémon hunter herself, since it would take a long time for an [[Officer Jenny]] to arrive for assistance due to them living in a remote village. However, Dr. White discouraged her to do so, saying it would be too dangerous. 

She later met up with Dr. White outside his clinic. Dr. White rushed outside, thinking she had gone after the Pokémon hunter herself as she had vowed. However, this was not the case. After [[Jessie]] realized how much Dr. White cared for Beatrice, she decided to continue on with {{TRT}} even though she had made plans to declare her love to him.
